comparison.objective: Grind peppercorns in a mortar while holding the mortar still.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization plus controlled circular pestle motion.
comparison.success_condition: Required grinding is completed, mortar remains safe, pestle is returned, and arms retreat.
comparison.reason: Shared reaction stabilization is generic; this tests repeated material-processing motion rather than threaded setting and locking.
